slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: IT support in Leeds: frequently asked questions

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Question 1
slots.default: Do you have an office in Leeds?

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: No. Our offices are at 124 City Rd in London and Caxton Point in Stevenage, and we would rather say so than list a virtual address in Leeds. The city is covered by our UK service desk plus field engineers who travel to customer sites. Most issues never need a visit: we respond the same working day and resolve most issues remotely. When a visit is requested we aim to have an engineer with you the same working day.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: You support a financial services firm in Leeds. Do you work with regulated businesses?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: We do support financial services firms, and what they need is usually unglamorous rather than exotic: tight access control, enforced multi-factor authentication, email that is properly secured, and backups that have been tested by actually restoring from them. We are Cyber Essentials Certified ourselves. We are an IT provider rather than a compliance consultancy, so we support your obligations rather than signing them off.

slots.label: Question 3
slots.default: Can you help with backup and business continuity?

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: Yes, and it is worth separating the two. Backup is having a copy; continuity is knowing how quickly you could actually be working again, and from what. We cover Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace backup as well as wider continuity and disaster recovery planning.

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: Faults are graded P1 to P5, each with its own SLA. P1 means the business cannot operate, a total outage or a dead server, and gets immediate attention. Everything below still carries a committed response time, so lower-priority tickets are not left to drift.

slots.label: Question 5
slots.default: Can you work alongside our internal IT?

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: Yes, and it is a common arrangement. We can take the day-to-day tickets, monitoring and patching so your internal person concentrates on projects and the things only they can do, or we can sit behind them as escalation and holiday cover only.
